hadith:
Agriculture - Narrated Ibn `Umar:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the land of Khaibar to the Jew's on the condition that they work on it and cultivate it, and be given half of its yield.
message: Turn to your Lord with sincere repentance and righteous deeds before the Day of Judgment arrives, for He alone—Al Qayyoom, The Self-Existing—sustains all creation and is ever-watchful of our actions. Just as the Prophet (ﷺ) taught us to work the earth and share its fruits, strive earnestly in both spiritual and worldly matters, knowing that everything depends on Allah's mercy and maintaining your connection with Him is the foundation of true success.
name:
Al Qayyoom - الْقَيُّومُ - The Self Existing

The name Al Qayyoom emphasizes Allah's self-sufficiency and His absolute power in sustaining His creation. It highlights the concept that everything depends on Him for existence and continuity, as He is always present and aware of all that happens. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'Qama,' which means 'to stand' or 'to maintain.' Al Qayyoom reflects the idea that Allah is the everlasting and ever-watchful guardian of all beings.
verse:
Ash-Shuraa - The Consultation - 42:47

Respond to your Lord before the coming of a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. There will be no refuge for you then, nor ˹grounds for˺ denial ˹of sins˺.
